mapper.select: SELECT id, userId, passWord, nickName, createTime, isWithDraw, status FROM user WHERE userId = #{id} AND passWord = #{password} AND status != 'DELETE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (userId, passWord, nickName, createTime, isWithDraw, status, updateTime, isAdmin) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{nickName}, #{createTime}, #{isWithDraw}, #{status}, #{updateTime}, #{admin})
